scope: Rigorous, bounded independent target counting for separated Hermitian row disks; no actual industrial positive claim

implementation_contract.function: certify_gapped(matrix, values, vectors, config, *, budget=None, check=None)
implementation_contract.input: Strictly Hermitian canonical CSR and bounded NumPy candidate arrays; float32/float64/complex64/complex128
implementation_contract.result: CERTIFIED only after independent count, per-group association, exact residual and local/global subspace proofs; otherwise UNVERIFIED

proof_chain: Exact IEEE dyadic coefficients; conservative rational row radius sum(abs(real)+abs(imag)); exact Hermitian equality, no symmetrization.
Separated union of k enlarged Gershgorin disks contains exactly k eigenvalues counting multiplicity; no pivot signs or candidate eigensolver used.

Nearest window is selected solely from original matrix row disks: inner maximal radial extent strictly below all remaining disks nearest radial extent. Two independently countable boundaries contain exactly k roots.
Interval targets use a strict partition of every disk into inside/left/right; only isolated radius-zero rows can resolve exact zero/endpoints. Ambiguous disks refuse.
Exact original residual L1 upper bound divided by component norm lower bound encloses a true root; value enclosure radius retains the prior stringent relative fidelity guard.
Candidate enclosures form disjoint groups. Inter-group midpoints must be independently countable and root-free; each partition count equals group column count.
Any group with multiple candidates additionally needs an independent count in its tight residual enclosure union. Whole-target counts cannot substitute for cluster multiplicity.

Exact Gram diagonal-dominance lower bound delta and residual leakage B prove projection rank when B^2<delta. B^2/delta<=1e-8 proves the whole-span principal-angle threshold 1e-4, locally and globally.
Angle display uses an integer upward square-root bound and outward floating rounding. Empty certificates perform a final cancellation/time guard.

large_synthetic_positive.matrix: Sparse nontridiagonal three-row low block plus disjoint gapped band; only three-row block uses a dense test reference. No large eigensolve.

verification.full_suite: Not run by this subagent; root controls full regression and release.

limitations: Requires separated exact row-disk unions and independently countable candidate separators; overlapping disks cause conservative UNVERIFIED.
Repeated non-diagonal clusters whose tight enclosures cannot be counted remain UNVERIFIED; no generic large sparse completeness guarantee.
Fixed-k certification only; no silent cluster expansion, target change or coefficient modification.
In-process time limits are cooperative, checked between bounded operations. Caller must retain existing worker memory/deadline guards.
Numerical acceptance is a separate original-problem validation gate; this module proves target association/coverage under its explicit conditions.
No floating MUMPS inertia is promoted to an exact certificate, no independent reference file or known matrix name enters the proof.
